# Basic Dark

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-basic-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-basic-dark)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-basic-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-basic-dark)

Basic Dark is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Basic family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-basic-dark codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `basicDark` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { basicDark } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-basic-dark';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, basicDark],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `basicDark` | `Extension` |
| `basicDarkMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#1e2124` |
| Active line | `#282b2f` |
| Selection | `#2a3953` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#ffcb6b` | bold | 10.79:1 | 9.48:1 | 7.74:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#ffcb6b` | bold | 10.79:1 | 9.48:1 | 7.74:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#d284e9` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#d284e9` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#61afef` | - | 6.85:1 | 6.02:1 | 4.91:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#61afef` | - | 6.85:1 | 6.02:1 | 4.91:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#61afef` | - | 6.85:1 | 6.02:1 | 4.91:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#56b6c2` | - | 6.83:1 | 6.00:1 | 4.90:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#56b6c2` | - | 6.83:1 | 6.00:1 | 4.90:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#56b6c2` | italic | 6.83:1 | 6.00:1 | 4.90:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#61afef` | italic | 6.85:1 | 6.02:1 | 4.91:1 |
| String | `string` | `#98c379` | - | 8.02:1 | 7.05:1 | 5.76:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#98c379` | - | 8.02:1 | 7.05:1 | 5.76:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#e2e2e2` | background, active line, selection | 8.96:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#a2a2a2` | gutter | 5.98:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#ffffff` | background, active line | 14.22:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#5c88da` | background | 4.61:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #d284e9a0` | background, active line | 3.09:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#5c88da90, 1px solid #5c88da` | background (fill or outline) | 4.61:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#3a59916f` | active line | 1.22:1 | Pass |
